title: Kekkon: Marriage
overview:
A new-sensation game that simulates "marriage" brightly, cheerfully and dramatically has finally arrived!!

Marriage lets you live out an imaginary life with the partner of your dreams, featuring the grown-up cast of the Sotsugyou series. Play as a man or a woman: enter your name, age and yearly income, then set your budget for living expenses.

On weekdays you attend self-improvement classes, and on weekends you invite your partner out on dates, keeping track of plans with your organizer and phone. A bigger income means more fatigue, so make time to rest. When the moment is right, propose - then meet the parents, pick a ring and choose a honeymoon destination.

- Playable by both men and women
- A cast of ten popular voice actors

「結婚」を明るく、楽しく、ドラマティックにシミュレートした新感覚ゲームついに登場!!
